description: Look up a UMD professor or teaching assistant by name on PlanetTerp. Returns the courses they have taught, their average rating, and student reviews. No login needed.

name.description: Name of the professor, e.g. "Jon Snow"

name: planetterp_get_professor

average_rating.description: Average student rating, on a 1-5 scale; null if the professor has no reviews

courses.description: Courses this professor has taught; a code repeats once per section taught

course.description: Course code the review was written for, e.g. "CMSC131"; null if it was not tied to a course

created.description: When the review was posted, as an ISO 8601 timestamp

expected_grade.description: Grade the student expected, e.g. "A", "B+"; empty string if not given

professor.description: Name of the professor the review is about

rating.description: Star rating the student gave, from 1 to 5

review.description: Full text of the student review

slug.description: PlanetTerp's unique identifier for the professor; their page is https://planetterp.com/professor/<slug>

type.description: "ta" if this person is a teaching assistant, "professor" otherwise

title: Get a professor
